summary: Provision time-limited cross-account AWS role and GCP SA binding for analytics hybrid tool access
description:
Background:
Analytics wants to run an ad-hoc nightly join of production S3 snapshots with BigQuery export data. The analytics tooling ('data-bridge') runs in the staging account and needs read-only access to a restricted S3 prefix in production plus BigQuery read access to a specific export dataset.

Request:
- Create an AWS cross-account role in PROD account that allows sts:AssumeRole from the data-bridge role in STAGING.
- Attach a least-privilege policy scoped to s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket for prefix 's3://redwood-prod-analytics/exports/analytics/'.
- Create a GCP IAM binding granting roles/bigquery.dataViewer on project:redwood-prod-exports and only the dataset analytics_export to the staging service account analytics-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com.
- Mark all created principals with ticket tag INT-46789 and set expiration (7 days) using our access-expiration tagging convention.
- Ensure CloudTrail and GCP Audit Logs are configured to surface these AssumeRole and SA impersonation events.

Justification:
- This is a time-limited data pull requested by the Product Analytics team to validate a migration and does not require broad permissions. A follow-up schedule will be created if repeated pulls are required.

Requested duration: 7 days (automatic review after expiration).

Provided details (from reporter):
- PROD AWS account id: 111122223333
- STAGING AWS account id: 444455556666
- S3 prefix: s3://redwood-prod-analytics/exports/analytics/
- GCP project: redwood-prod-exports
- BigQuery dataset: analytics_export
- Staging GCP service account: analytics-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com

Least-privilege policy example (AWS) - apply only to role in PROD account (note: this snippet is illustrative; infra will format as managed policy):
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
      "Resource": [
        "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-analytics",
        "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-prod-analytics/exports/analytics/*"
      ]
    }
  ]
}

GCP binding example (illustrative):
- grant roles/bigquery.dataViewer on resource projects/redwood-prod-exports/datasets/analytics_export to analytics-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com

Audit/logging requirement:
- Enable CloudTrail lookup for AssumeRole events and add a log alert in #security-ops for any unexpected principals.
- Confirm that BigQuery access is visible via GCP Audit Logs and exported to the centralized logging project for retention.

Acceptance criteria:
- A new role in PROD with ARN arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/INT-46789-analytics-readonly exists and can be assumed by arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/data-bridge-staging only.
- Attached AWS policy only allows the listed S3 actions on the specified prefix.
- Staging GCP service account has roles/bigquery.dataViewer on the analytics_export dataset only.
- Expiration policy or scheduled job to remove bindings after 7 days is in place and documented.
- Audit logs confirm at least one successful AssumeRole and one BigQuery read access during the window.
steps_to_provision: Validate account IDs and principal ARNs with requestor
Create AWS role in PROD with AssumeRole trust policy limited to staging principal
Attach least-privilege inline policy or managed policy to the role
Create a tag on the role: 'redwood:access_ticket' = 'INT-46789' and 'redwood:expires' = '2026-03-22'
In GCP, grant roles/bigquery.dataViewer to analytics-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com scoped to dataset analytics_export
Schedule a Cloud Scheduler job to remove AWS role/GCP binding on expiration date or open a removal ticket for on-call
Verify access by running a smoke test from staging: list S3 prefix and run a limited BigQuery SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analytics_export.__TABLES__
Confirm logs appear in CloudTrail and GCP Audit Logs and add a short note to #security-ops channel
acceptance_criteria: Role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/INT-46789-analytics-readonly exists and trust policy only allows the staging data-bridge role
S3 access limited to the specified bucket/prefix and only s3:ListBucket/s3:GetObject are allowed
GCP binding limited to dataset analytics_export and verified via IAM policy explorer
Smoke test logs attached to this ticket showing successful list/get and BigQuery read

resolution: Created AWS role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/INT-46789-analytics-readonly with trust policy limited to arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/data-bridge-staging. Attached inline policy restricting access to s3://redwood-prod-analytics/exports/analytics/. GCP binding granted roles/bigquery.dataViewer on dataset analytics_export to analytics-staging@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Resources tagged with INT-46789 and expiration date set to 2026-03-22. Smoke tests passed and audit logging configured. Follow-up: Product Analytics to confirm final dataset consumption and file a new ticket if repeated access is required.
